anchor: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: master character reference sheet for F033 Graveyard Shift Diner, a hand-painted 2D folk-horror diner management game. Wide landscape sheet on solid dark night-blue #0E1418. DOT, one consistent tired cook-waitress in her mid-40s, broad practical build, square expressive face, small hooked nose, tired eyes, graying dark hair pinned into a short bun, pencil behind right ear, teal #2F6F73 uniform dress, worn white apron, comfortable black work shoes, small legible name badge DOT. TOP ROW: full-body front, exact side profile facing right, full-body back, all equal height. BOTTOM ROW: three separate full-body gameplay poses facing right: serving a plate, pouring coffee from glass pot into an actual held cup, leaning in to inspect a customer's hands. Keep every figure separated with generous gutters, intact feet and props, no overlaps. Hand-painted 2D flat shading, deliberate brush edges, restrained material wear on apron and shoes; NOT pixel art, NOT 3D. Overhead green-white fluorescent key #E8F5E1, restrained red neon edge #E63946 from left. Muted chrome #C9CED6, coffee brown #5B3A29, fog gray #7D8A8F. No gore, no extra fingers, no plastic sheen, no blue-purple glow, no sparkle filler, no depth of field, no decorative text or UI. Consistent anatomy and identity across all six views. Character anchor art, not a claimed finished animation atlas.
